children: Palantir Technologies (PLTR, Financials) is displaying potent AI-driven growth, but its fast stock surge has returned valuation to the center of the debate.

Palantir reported Q2 revenue growth of 92.83% year-over-year to $1.935 billion and adjusted profits per share of $0.41, exceeding the $0.28 consensus estimate. U.S. commercial sales jumped 149%, highlighting the strength of demand for the company's AI software.
The stock has likewise been on a tear, rising more than 60% from its June low of $106.37 to a recent $207.52.

That momentum has produced a huge disconnect between Palantir's growth story and its value. In the most recent report, the stock was trading around $183.03, while 24/7 Wall St. set its 12-month price target at $185.99.

The bull case remains linked to AI adoption, particularly desire for sovereign AI. CEO Alex Karp said he expected sovereign AI demand to buoy growth in line with or above its U.S. commercial business over the next 18 months.
Analysts have also continued to raise earnings expectations, with the study noting 26 positive revisions to fiscal 2027 EPS projections in the prior 30 days and no lower revisions.
The next catalyst will be if Palantir can continue to develop its commercial business and profitability at a high pace with the stock's value remaining elevated.

title: Palantir's Huge Rally Has Wall Street Asking a New Question
